name: 常染色体優性多発性嚢胞腎

summary.text: A rare, genetic, renal tubular disease characterized by progressive outgrowths of fluid-filled cysts from the renal epithelium, which can manifest with hematuria, urinary tract infections, hypertension, and abdominal or flank pain. The slowly progressive loss of kidney function may evolve to end stage kidney disease (ESKD).
